title: W9 B4 -- Make Open beside replace the pane last used
description: Follow section '### B4 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: split.test.ts, tests/w9-open-beside.spec.ts and split-view spec pass. Browser test port: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1437. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/B4.md.

review.note: Approved (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2). src/split.ts: one added line, 'if (split && target.kind === "entry") return select(split, target.id);' plus the doc comment; signature and callers untouched; no-split and PDF paths keep the old body. select() gives exactly plan cases b/c/d (focused pane replaced; target already in the other pane -> focus moves). Unit cases a-e present in src/split.test.ts; fail-first recorded (2 failed before). Re-pins follow the plan default and quote the old expectations in B4.md: split.test.ts two cases; tests/split-view.spec.ts ~:427 now clicks the right editor before 'Open Two beside', keeping that test's intent (delete the right pane's entry closes the split), no assertion weakened. Fresh runs: npx vitest run src/split.test.ts -> pass (25); PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1437 npx playwright test tests/w9-open-beside.spec.ts tests/split-view.spec.ts --output test-results/T261-review -> 28/28 passed (the worker's split-view:243 failure did not recur). Minor: case (e) PDF is only unit-tested with the right pane focused. Behaviour change worth the owner's hand check: Cmd/Ctrl+click on a sidebar row with a split open now also replaces the focused pane (same openBeside path).

log.note: openBeside: entry target with a split open now returns select(split, target.id) -- replaces the pane last used; focus moves when the entry is already in the other pane. No split / PDF target: old body unchanged; callers and signature untouched. Unit: src/split.test.ts 25/25 (new cases b-e; fail-first: 2 failed then 1 failed before the change). tsc -b clean. Browser: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1437, w9-open-beside + split-view, isolated --output: 27 passed / 1 failed; the failed case (split-view:243) reran alone and passed 1/1 in 19.6 s -- the full-run failure was a vite dev-server reload from another worker's edits (Playwright log: page navigated to http://127.0.0.1:1437/ mid-test), and an earlier run lost 8 cases to the shared test-results wipe (coordinator #1261). New spec passed in both full runs. Re-pinned per the plan's authorised default (old expectations quoted in notes/B4.md): split.test.ts 'replaces the right pane of an open split' (old: focused-left + entry c -> right becomes c, focused right; now left becomes c, focused left) and 'does nothing for the entry already on the left' (old: openBeside(pair,b,entry a) toBe pair; now focus moves left); split-view.spec.ts:385 test re-pinned by focusing the right pane before the final open-beside click so the delete-closes-split flow keeps its intent; comments updated. Full detail: docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/B4.md. Hand check for owner in the note. tsc note: earlier run had errors in blankClick.test.ts:54 and registry.test.ts (owners T262/T266); clean on final run.
